facts.business: Yatra Online Limited is an Indian online travel company providing travel services to consumers and corporate clients, including flights, hotels, packages, and expense management solutions.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding queries from NSE and SEBI on IPO proceeds utilization of INR 3,391.44 million till June 30, 2024; management asserts compliance with Offer Document.

key_risks: Foreign currency risk due to exchange rate fluctuations
Contingent liabilities from consumer claims, service tax, income tax, and GST demands
Goodwill impairment risk following reallocation to Air and Hotel & Packages CGUs
Dependence on key personnel and management team
Regulatory and compliance risks in travel industry
